description: Corpus reference profile: YAML 1.2.2 Core schema resolution (section 10.3), duplicate mapping keys rejected as required by section 3.2.1.1, '<<' treated as an ordinary key (merge is not part of YAML 1.2), integers exact and unbounded, every document in the stream resolved. A scalar with a tag outside the Core schema is reported as tagged, with its text kept as a string. Floats are reported as binary64 bit patterns rounded to nearest, ties to even.
